_tierLegend.A: Public ATS API confirmed reachable (Greenhouse/Lever/Workday CXS) — scripts/scan.mjs hits these directly, zero WebSearch cost.
_tierLegend.B: Known BFSI employer with real India tech footprint, ATS not confirmed as public JSON — reach via WebFetch on careers page or WebSearch.
_tierLegend.C: No usable ATS at all — LinkedIn/Naukri/WebSearch only.
_tierLegend.priorityNote: priority: 'low' means comp data or reputation signal suggests this employer is unlikely to clear 25 LPA at 2-4yr, or headcount is too thin to justify daily polling. Kept in the registry (don't delete) in case a specific req proves the estimate wrong — just poll less often / weight lower.

_atsAdapters.workday: POST https://{tenant}.{wdHost}.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/jobs  body: {"appliedFacets":{},"limit":50,"offset":0,"searchText":"<keyword>"} — verified live 2026-08-09 for visa, mastercard, db
